test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at 'PQ' as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77d1d683be503dda53403c538fe279c9e8be42bb39182da786c73cde589e2d83.png]
solution:
The correct answer is option(3)

When a mirror is placed vertically to the object, the image so formed will be laterally inverted. In other words, the** Left Hand Side** and** Right Hand Side** interchange their positions while top and bottom will remain same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/443cca165019d9e771b26b8691b9df2871313fd3c42bf38e8e3f228c6c77db27.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **option(3). **
